settings.headline: 5 reasons people are switching to a body cream with a 7-ingredient base this winter
settings.intro: From Real Skin Care. A popular drugstore coconut lotion lists 34 ingredients on its label. Our Coconut Moisturizer starts from a 7-ingredient base you can read in one breath, and one 4oz jar is $28. Here is why people are making the switch.
settings.hero_alt: Real Skin Care Coconut Breeze moisturizing body cream, open jar beside fresh coconut

settings.title: You can read the whole label.
settings.body: Our cream starts from a 7-ingredient base: purified spring water plus six organic ingredients, virgin coconut oil, plant-based emulsifying wax, palm stearic, grapefruit seed extract, beeswax and red palm oil. Scented versions add their scent on top, and Pure Unscented is the base alone. A popular drugstore coconut lotion lists 34 ingredients.
settings.media_alt: Creator showing the short ingredient list on the Coconut Breeze jar
settings.caption: I couldn't even find the ingredients list. It's so short.

settings.title: It's thick enough for heels, hands and elbows.
settings.body: It goes on like butter and works in without leaving a slick film. Beeswax and coconut oil make it richer than a lotion, so it is made for the spots that get dry first when the weather turns cold.
settings.media_alt: Creator pressing a finger into the cream in an open Coconut Breeze jar
settings.caption: Ever wonder what butter feels like on your skin?

settings.title: A little goes a long way.
settings.body: A small scoop covers a lot of skin. Used every night, one 4oz jar lasts about a month, which works out to under $1 a day.
settings.media_alt: Creator scooping cream from the jar and smoothing it onto her leg
settings.caption: Just scoop some up. It just glides right in.

settings.heading: What customers say
settings.quote_1: I'm obsessed with all things Real Skin Care. This is THE moisturizer for Wisconsin winters for my whole family. It's long lasting and doesn't feel greasy. We use it all over and love it!
settings.quote_2: Incredibly soft. Doesn’t make you feel greasy or sticky after use. It makes you feel incredibly moisturized.
settings.quote_3: The smell is perfect & it just glides onto the skin like butter! It doesnt leave a greasy residue like some other brands!

settings.title: The scent is natural, not added fragrance.
settings.body: Coconut Breeze gets its light coconut scent from organic coconut oil extract. Lavender & Rose, Calming Lavender and Rose Petal use organic essential oils, and Pure Unscented has nothing added at all. No synthetic fragrance and no parabens.
settings.media_alt: Open jar of Coconut Breeze body cream with coconut pieces

settings.title: Try it for 30 days.
settings.body: If you don't love it, email us within 30 days and we will refund you. You don't have to send the jar back.
settings.media_alt: A customer smoothing body cream onto her arm

settings.note_1: Beeswax firms up in the cold. Warm a little between your fingers and it spreads easily.
settings.note_2: Real coconut oil can separate a little in the jar. That is normal, and a quick stir brings it back together.
